info.name: Helpdesk
info.summary: Ask your IT provider for help, from inside Nextcloud
Bed jeres IT-leverandør om hjælp, direkte fra Nextcloud
info.description:
Helpdesk gives everyone in your Nextcloud one place to ask for IT help.
- Your IT provider is shown as the contact: name, phone, email, opening hours and the people there - Describe the problem, mark it urgent if it is, and attach screenshots - Requests always reach your provider: they are saved first and sent again until the mail goes through, and admins are told if it keeps failing - Each person sees their requests, open or solved, can write more or add a note, and mark them solved - An IT contact in the company (a group you choose) sees everyone's requests - Replies come by email, straight to the person who asked - One receiver at a time: switch between providers in the settings - Providers that deliver Nextcloud to their customers can lock the receiver in the server configuration
Works with any helpdesk that receives email. With Ticket system for Nextcloud, each request becomes a ticket for the person who wrote it.
info.author: Co-Optimize
